A progress band above the prompt shows the current step and what is running now, and a new `/desk-activity` pane shows what ran when, so a long wait is no longer a blank spinner.

- While a turn runs, two lines sit above the prompt: the current step on top, what runs now below
- The step is the task list from `TodoWrite` or `TaskCreate` when the session has them (`✓ 2  ◉ Verifying 8m 2s  ○ Clean up +1   2/5`); Claude Code leaves those tools out for Claude 5 models, so there the step is the first sentence Claude wrote before its latest tool call (`✓ 2  ◉ Now running it on .12.   step 3`). Nothing is asked of Claude and no tokens are spent
- The lower line shows the running tool call and its time, and for a shell command the program it started and its CPU (`▶ Verify cursor reads · 8m 2s · java 97%`, Linux), the running agents and what each is doing, or `Responding` while Claude writes
- When that program has used no CPU and no I/O for 3 minutes, `! no change 3m 10s` appears; network clients like `ssh` show it dim, since the remote side may be working
- The lower line appears after 10 seconds, or as soon as the upper line has a step, and the band folds when the turn ends; a longer turn leaves a dim `3 commands (1 failed) · 2 agents · tasks 5/5` under its end-of-turn line
- The band replaces the `Tasks` card above the prompt
- New `/desk-activity` pane (or click the band's lower line): what ran this turn, or the last one. Time bars for the main conversation, each agent the turn started and its background shells (`░` explore, `▓` edit, `▒` test, `━` command or agent, `─` responding), the flow of Claude's notes and calls with times (reads folded into one line, edits with `+N −M`, commands and tests with `✓`/`✗`/`▶`), and the turn's agents and background shells, a running shell with the last line of its output

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
